_doc: Stomp styles: how a Hunter's stomp on an enemy wisp looks (StompLook). Every style keeps the stomp's timing (Life.R stomp_time and stomp_cycle); only the body changes. A style lists what it changes from 'base'. 'hunter' marks a Hunter's own default (always owned); a style with 'cost' is a cosmetic bought with gems and worn in the 'stomp' slot (Save.d.look.stomp). foot: r | l | both | alt (right, then left). lift and knee: hip and knee angles in radians at the top of the lift. lean: forward tilt in radians. crouch: 0..1 how low the standing leg sits. arms: out (left arm out for balance) | wide (both out) | up (both fists overhead, down with the slam) | fists (both fists hammer the ground) | hips (hands on hips) | weapon (the weapon stays in hand).

thunder_stomp.name: Thunder Stomp
thunder_stomp.desc: Both feet down together like a dropped anvil, fists high.
